handbookNote: TDLR Motorcycle Operator Training Manual 2020-2021 (Rev. 9/1/2020), Texas Department of Licensing & Regulation -- price matches this project's established Motorcycle tier ($7.99), not a placeholder. EXAM MECHANICS HEDGE: the manual itself confirms the Class M knowledge test is NOT required for most applicants -- it is waived for anyone who completes a TDLR-approved motorcycle operator training course and presents the completion certificate (valid 2 years); by statute, only applicants restricted to a moped license must take the Class M knowledge test (manual p.3 'Adult Motorcycle Operator Licensing' and p.50 'Earning Your License'). Neither TDLR (tdlr.texas.gov) nor Texas DPS (dps.texas.gov, which administers the actual knowledge test) publish an official item count or passing percentage for this test anywhere checked this session; third-party test-prep sites disagree (20-question/80% vs 25-question/80%, both claimed, neither sourced to an official page). Per project convention for unconfirmed motorcycle-category mechanics, this track should use a 25-question / 80%-pass (20 correct) stand-in when wired -- matching the format independently confirmed for CA, GA, MI, VA, and WA motorcycle tracks in this project -- but this specific number is NOT officially confirmed for Texas and MUST be flagged as an unconfirmed stand-in in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time, same convention as other hedged tracks (e.g. mn_driver).
